notes.title: [Version] V1.112
notes.content:
(1) Optimize terrain resources and add deserts and Arctic snow regions.

(2) Add some sect buildings and NPCs.

(3) Optimize the overall UI interface, sound effects, and some skill effects.

(4) Modify some skill damage and gain attribute values.

(5) Increase the function of alchemists, dividing them into first to ninth grade alchemists from low to high, and taking pills is not limited by their realm.

(6) Open the Golden Elixir and Primordial Infant monsters and bosses.

(7) Add monster distribution and explosion rate information to the big map.

(8) Add the function of deleting character files.

(9) Modify flight function: During the foundation period, you can fly with flying magic weapons, while during the Golden Elixir period and above, you can fly without using magic weapons. During flight, simply press the Tab key.

(10) Optimize some monster kills to gain experience.

(11) Add game sound switch.

(12) If there is insufficient mana during modification flight, it will not stop flying.

(13) Increase items in the Golden Elixir and Yuanying sect's supply stores.

(14) Optimize the targeting and range of some monster attacks.

(15) Optimize scene lighting and fog effects.

(16) Fixed an abnormal failure bug during alchemy.

notes.title: [Version] V1.103
notes.content:
① Optimize some map model resources.

② Limit the cooling time of the Boosting Pill to 6 hours for use.

③ Adjust the percentage of damage caused by certain techniques.

④ Fixed a bug where some dropped items do not display their names.

⑤ Fixed a bug with abnormal refresh time for some materials.

notes.title: Update version V1.102
notes.content:
① The resolution setting has been modified. If there is any abnormal lag or screen blur, please switch to a 1k resolution.

② Increase the display of names for wild resources and dropped resources.

③ Modify the way to obtain dew in the wild to be picked up together with other plants.

④ Add instructional video function for operation.
